section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种锂离子电池，包括正极极片和负极极片，所述正极极片和负极极片相互叠加卷绕成型，最内层的所述正极极片贴设有用以缓冲的第一胶片，最内层的所述负极极片贴设有用以缓冲的第二胶片，所述第一胶片和第二胶片相对设置。本实用新型在最内层的正极极片上贴设第一胶片，最内层的负极极片上贴设第二胶片，可以进一步对卷芯最内层的宽度进行控制，卷芯不会因为卷绕张力过大或过小影响卷芯的尺寸，对卷芯最内层的正极极片表面涂覆的正极材料和最内层的负极极片表面涂覆的负极材料进行缓冲，避免其因为折度过大而发生破裂，提高锂离子电池在卷绕过程中的优良率和保证锂离子电池在充放电过程中良好的离子导通性能。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, including positive pole piece and negative pole piece, positive pole piece and negative pole piece overlap each other and convolute the shaping, the inlayer positive pole piece pastes and is equipped with the first film for the buffering, the inlayer negative pole piece pastes and is equipped with the second film for the buffering, first film and second film set up relatively. The utility model discloses paste on the anodal pole piece of inlayer and establish first film, paste on the negative pole piece of inlayer and establish the second film, can further control the width of rolling up the core inlayer, roll up the core can not influence the size of rolling up the core because of coiling tension too big or undersize, the anodal material of the anodal pole piece surface coating of rolling up the core inlayer and the negative pole piece surface coating's of inlayer negative pole material cushion, avoid it to take place to break because the book degree is too big, improve the goodness rate of lithium ion battery at the coiling in-process and guarantee the good ion conductivity of lithium ion battery at the charging and discharging in-process.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a battery field, in particular to lithium ion battery.

Background

The lithium ion battery has the advantages of high energy density, long cycle life, no memory effect, wide working temperature, environmental protection and the like, is a main energy source of new energy automobiles and various mobile electronic devices, and the market usage amount of the lithium ion battery is continuously increased.

In the traditional battery cell winding process, the positive electrode material on the positive electrode plate and the negative electrode material on the negative electrode plate are coated on two sides, although the coating thicknesses of the positive electrode plate and the negative electrode plate can be consistent through the two-side coating. However, the folding degree of the copper notch at the head of the negative electrode pole piece at the innermost layer of the winding core and the aluminum notch at the head of the positive electrode pole piece is close to 180 degrees during winding, so that the positive and negative electrode materials on the pole pieces are easy to break, the yield of the winding process is low, and the electrochemical performance of the battery is poor.

In the prior art, the head of the positive pole piece and the head of the negative pole piece are coated on one side for a certain length, so that positive and negative materials are not arranged at a copper notch and an aluminum notch of the innermost layer during winding, and the winding yield and the electrochemical performance of the battery cannot be influenced due to breakage of the positive and negative materials. However, the single-side coating of the head parts of the positive and negative pole pieces can cause severe curling of the head parts of the pole pieces, and the production quality and the winding effect are affected.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a technical problem to the defect that exists among the above-mentioned prior art, provide a lithium ion battery to solve the problem that proposes in the above-mentioned background art.

In order to solve the technical problem, the utility model discloses the technical scheme who takes as follows: the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, includes positive pole piece and negative pole piece, positive pole piece and the mutual stack winding of negative pole piece are formed, the inlayer positive pole piece subsides are equipped with the first film for the buffering, the inlayer negative pole piece subsides are equipped with the second film for the buffering, first film and second film set up relatively.

As a further elaboration of the above technical solution:

in the above technical scheme, the end of the first film is flush with the end of the positive electrode plate, and the end of the second film is flush with the end of the negative electrode plate.

In the above technical solution, the lengths of the first film and the second film are both set to the width of the winding needle of the lithium ion battery.

In the above technical scheme, the positive pole piece includes that the anodal mass flow body and two-sided coating are in anodal material on the anodal mass flow body, first film is attached on the anodal material.

In the above technical scheme, the negative pole piece includes that the negative pole current collector and two-sided coating are in negative pole material on the negative pole current collector, the second film is attached on the negative pole material.

In the above technical solution, the positive current collector is a member made of aluminum foil, and the negative current collector is a member made of copper foil.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that:

1. the utility model discloses paste on the anodal pole piece of inlayer and establish first film, paste on the negative pole piece of inlayer and establish the second film, can further control the width of rolling up the core inlayer, roll up the core can not influence the size of rolling up the core because of coiling tension too big or undersize, the anodal material of the anodal pole piece surface coating of rolling up the core inlayer and the negative pole piece surface coating's of inlayer negative pole material cushion, avoid it to take place to break because the book degree is too big, improve the goodness rate of lithium ion battery at the coiling in-process and guarantee the good ion conductivity of lithium ion battery at the charging and discharging in-process.

2. The utility model discloses well cathode material and negative pole material all adopt two-sided coating for the cathode material on cathode plate surface and the negative pole material on negative pole plate surface's thickness is even unanimous, and guarantees that the head of cathode plate and negative pole piece levels, can not take place to curl, and coating process is simple simultaneously, easily operation.

As shown in fig. 1-5, a lithium ion battery includes a positive electrode sheet 1 and a negative electrode sheet 2, the positive electrode sheet 1 and the negative electrode sheet 2 are overlapped and wound to form, a first film 3 for buffering is attached to the innermost positive electrode sheet 1, a second film 4 for buffering is attached to the innermost negative electrode sheet 2, and the first film 3 and the second film 4 are arranged oppositely. Through attached first film 3 and second film 4 to roll up 1 surface coating's of the utmost point pole piece of inlayer positive electrode material 6 and 2 surface coating's of the utmost point pole piece 8 of buffering, avoid it to take place to break because the degree of folding is too big, improve the excellent rate of lithium ion battery at the coiling in-process and guarantee the good ion conductivity of lithium ion battery at the charge-discharge in-process.

In this embodiment, as shown in fig. 2 and 3, the end of the first film 3 is flush with the end of the positive electrode tab 1, and the end of the second film 4 is flush with the end of the negative electrode tab 2. The lengths of the first film 3 and the second film 4 are set to be the width of a winding needle of the lithium ion battery. The first film sheet 3 and the second film sheet 4 can further control the width of the innermost layer of the winding core, and the size of the winding core cannot be influenced by too large or too small winding tension of the winding core. The thicknesses of the first film 3 and the second film 4 are set according to the thickness of the lithium ion battery required actually, as long as the positive electrode material 6 of the positive electrode plate 3 and the negative electrode material 8 of the negative electrode plate 2 can be buffered to avoid breakage, which is not limited in this embodiment.

Specifically, as shown in fig. 4 and 5, the positive electrode sheet 1 includes a positive electrode current collector 5 and a positive electrode material 6 coated on both sides of the positive electrode current collector 5, and the first rubber sheet 3 is attached to the positive electrode material 6. The negative pole piece 1 comprises a negative pole current collector 7 and a negative pole material 8 coated on the negative pole current collector 7, and the second film 4 is attached to the negative pole material 8.

Preferably, the positive current collector 5 is a member made of aluminum foil, and the negative current collector 7 is a member made of copper foil, so that good chemical performance of the lithium ion battery is effectively guaranteed.

The utility model discloses paste on the positive pole piece 1 of inlayer and establish first film 3, the second film 4 is established in 2 subsides of negative pole piece of inlayer, can further control the width of rolling up the core inlayer, it can not roll up the size of core because the too big or undersize influence of winding tension to roll up the core, positive electrode material 6 to the 1 surface coating of positive pole piece of rolling up the core inlayer and negative pole piece 2 surface coating's of inlayer negative pole material 8 cushion, avoid it to take place to break because the degree of folding is too big, improve the acceptance rate of lithium ion battery at the coiling in-process and guarantee the good ion conductivity of lithium ion battery at the charging and discharging in-process.

The above is not intended to limit the technical scope of the present invention, and any modifications, equivalent changes and modifications made to the above embodiments according to the technical spirit of the present invention are all within the scope of the technical solution of the present invention.
